name: RA-FLS large-scale Boolean model
description: A large-scale Boolean model of rheumatoid arthritis fibroblast-like synoviocytes (RA-FLS), made of five submodels for apoptosis, cell proliferation, matrix degradation, bone erosion and inflammation. The submodels can be simulated independently or as one global model. Used to mimic mono and combination treatments and to propose targets and drug candidates for repurposing.
spatial_context: Intracellular signalling and regulatory network of a single cell type; no spatial structure is represented.

references.title: A large-scale Boolean model of the rheumatoid arthritis fibroblast-like synoviocytes predicts drug synergies in the arthritic joint.

prediction_scope: Whether the apoptosis, proliferation, matrix degradation, bone erosion and inflammation phenotypes are on or off under given inputs and perturbations.
